summary: Attack targeting follows the core rule: a target whose Force (or compared stat) is above the Attack's strength is legal to target and simply survives; an Attack may have no target. Removes the strength check from RequireLegalAttackTarget and updates ~40 tests that pinned the old rule (plus a new regression). Shared because the change is rules code plus many test files; no UI or wire change.
